description: Synthetic counter example; persistence is modeled in memory.

properties.counter.effect_once: Each operation ID produces at most one committed increment.
properties.counter.matches_history: Counter value equals the sum of distinct operations observed in the independent commit history.
properties.counter.acknowledged_durable: Every acknowledged operation has a durable receipt and exactly one observed committed effect after modeled restart.

assumptions: Checkpoint atomically publishes value and receipt.
Crashes discard pending requests and preserve the modeled durable state.
Operation IDs and deltas are fixed fixtures.
limits: No real filesystem, database, network, weak-memory or native-thread behavior is exercised.
